summary: Thiscall destructor: invokes a cleanup thunk on the object (ThunkToFUN00506ccc), then conditionally frees the object via FreeWrapper_7bcf when the low bit of flag a2 is set. Returns the this pointer. Standard MSVC deleting-destructor pattern; the flag bit selects self-free. Owning class unidentified.

local_names.a2: byte flag; bit 0 selects object free

operations.description: Call cleanup thunk ThunkToFUN00506ccc with this as argument.
Branch on (a2 & 1) != 0; only then free the object.
Conditionally call FreeWrapper_7bcf(this) to release the object allocation.

unresolved: Semantics of the cleanup performed by ThunkToFUN00506ccc are not in the packet; thunk target resolution is static-only.
Bit-0-of-a2 as the deleting-destructor flag is a DERIVED interpretation; exact caller convention unverified.
